title: Pittsburgh engagement with Miles and Coltrane listening
summary: In snowy Pittsburgh crowds line up for Dizzy's band while Miles and Coltrane watch from the audience.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Man, we would like--we would be playing. So we was in--I remember one incident. We was in Pittsburgh playing in a club. And Miles Davis was playing around the corner from us.
In a club. And boy it had snowed and Pittsburgh was--snowed so high.
And people--we would get the--come the white man and we would see people like in double lines around the corner, man, trying to get in to hear us, you know.
Where was that--working up on the Hill?
This band with Dizzy and ya'll were in Pittsburgh.
Yeah. So everynight, uhm, I would I would look out in the audience and it would be Colrane , Miles, everybody standing up there looking at us, listening at us play.
